handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex2 while Codex completes higher-priority work.

Vectorbt governed baseline closeout ready for review: added worker entrypoint, sample dataset, CI smoke job, and synced maturity/activation docs to the implemented smoke-tested baseline. Verified with python3 services/research/vectorbt/smoke_test.py, python3 -m pytest services/research/vectorbt/test_adapter.py -q, and python3 services/research/vectorbt/worker.py.

Changes requested per docs/reviews/2026-04-21-exec-oss-vectorbt-001-codex-review.md: enforce date validation in GovernedVectorbtInputAdapter, add regression tests, and sync integrations/vectorbt/integration.md to the implemented artifact/registry contract.

Vectorbt reopen fixes are ready for review: GovernedVectorbtInputAdapter now rejects missing/malformed YYYY-MM-DD dates, regression tests cover both paths, and integrations/vectorbt/integration.md matches the implemented artifact_bundle and registry_entry contract. Revalidated with python3 -m pytest services/research/vectorbt/test_adapter.py -q (30 passed, 5 subtests passed), python3 services/research/vectorbt/smoke_test.py, and python3 services/research/vectorbt/worker.py.

Review requested changes: GovernedVectorbtInputAdapter still accepts non-zero-padded dates like 2024-1-1 because datetime.strptime('%Y-%m-%d') is lenient, so the adapter does not actually enforce the documented YYYY-MM-DD contract. Tighten validation to require exact zero-padded ISO dates and add regression coverage for 2024-1-1/2024-01-1 style inputs before re-handoff.

Reopen fix is ready for review: GovernedVectorbtInputAdapter now enforces exact zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD dates, rejecting 2024-1-1 and 2024-01-1 before parsing. Added regression coverage for both malformed inputs and revalidated with python3 -m pytest services/research/vectorbt/test_adapter.py -q (32 passed, 5 subtests passed), python3 services/research/vectorbt/smoke_test.py, and python3 services/research/vectorbt/worker.py.

Re-review passed: exact zero-padded ISO date validation now matches the documented boundary, regression coverage and evidence docs are synced, and focused verification plus the prior reviewer repros all pass. Owner should finalize to done.
